title: Write ratings, labels and reject flags into original JPEG metadata
source: rapidroom (original JPEG metadata writer and native validation)
highlight: Optionally save culling decisions inside JPEGs without re-encoding pixels, with batch reports and Undo.
notes: Off by default. Writes XMP rating/label and updates existing EXIF rating fields using atomic metadata-only replacement; preserves scans, foreign metadata and file properties. Library manual write works independently of automatic embedding. Extended XMP and unsafe auxiliary-image offset changes are refused by name. Other formats retain existing sidecar behavior.
